newsitems.title: PGS 11 Final Stage Day 2 is LIVE!!
newsitems.author: JBowlerr
newsitems.contents: [p]Hello, PUBG Esports fans![/p][p align="start"]The final stretch of the 2026 PUBG Global Series is approaching: [b]PGS Circuit 4[/b]. With PGS 10, PGS 11, and the Circuit Final, PGS 12, the three remaining tournaments will bring this year’s 12-event PUBG Global Series to a close.[/p][p align="start"]Circuit 4 is more than just the final circuit of the season. With the conclusion of PGS 12, the [b]final PGS Points standings for the 2026 season will be determined, deciding the eight teams that will advance to PUBG Global Championship 2026.[/b][/p][p align="start"]After three circuits of competition, the race for PGC is beginning to take shape—but nothing has been decided yet. With PGS 10, PGS 11, and double points on the line at PGS 12, there are still [b]240 PGS Points[/b] up for grabs.[/p][p align="start"]Which teams will earn their way to PGC 2026 through PGS Points? Let’s take a closer look at [b]Circuit 4, the final competition of the 2026 PGS season.[/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/QYvMFGPC.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][h2][b]PGS Circuit 4 Schedule[/b][/h2][p align="start"]PGS Circuit 4 will take place from [b]October 14 to November 1[/b].[/p][list][*][p][b]PGS 10[/b][/p][list][*][p]Group Stage: October 14[/p][/*][*][p]Winners Stage: October 15[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Stage: October 16[/p][/*][*][p]Final Stage: October 17–18[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]PGS 11[/b][/p][list][*][p]Winners Stage: October 22[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Stage: October 23[/p][/*][*][p]Final Stage: October 24–25[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]PGS 12[/b][/p][list][*][p]Survival Stage: October 29[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Finals: October 30–November 1[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"]As the [b]Circuit Final[/b], PGS 12 will see the top eight teams in the Circuit 4 PGS Points standings advance directly to the Grand Finals based on the points accumulated through PGS 10 and PGS 11. The remaining 16 teams will compete in the Survival Stage for the remaining spots in the Grand Finals.[/p][p align="start"]When PGS 12 comes to an end, it will mark not only the conclusion of Circuit 4, but also the end of the [b]2026 season-long PGS Points race spanning PGS 1 through PGS 12.[/b][/p][p align="start"][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/dfU4pJIb.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/b] [/p][h2][b]PGS Points Standings[/b][/h2][p align="start"]With three circuits and nine PGS events now complete, the battle for PGS Points is more intense than ever.[/p][p align="start"]At the conclusion of Circuit 3, [b]Virtus.pro leads the standings with 261 points[/b], followed by Made in Thailand with 224 points, 17Gaming with 223 points, and T1 with 208 points.[/p][p align="start"]Currently occupying the final PGC qualification spot is [b]Petrichor Road in eighth place with 152 points.[/b][/p][p align="start"]But the gaps around the cutoff remain narrow. Seventh-place Falcons sit just two points ahead at 154, while ninth-place Gen.G Esports trail the current PGC qualification line by only seven points with 145.[/p][p align="start"]Most importantly, [b]Circuit 4 is still to come.[/b] The current standings are far from the final picture of who will advance to PGC.[/p][p align="start"] [img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/WQDtO1dg.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][h2][b]PGC 2026 Qualification & PGS Points[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The [b]top eight teams in the final PGS Points standings[/b], accumulated across PGS 1 through PGS 12 during the 2026 season, will qualify for PGC 2026.[/p][p align="start"]And the final standings determine more than just qualification. The higher a team finishes in the PGS Points standings, the [b]later the stage from which they will begin their PGC 2026 journey.[/b][/p][p align="start"]The team finishing [b]1st in PGS Points will advance directly to the PGC 2026 Grand Finals[/b]. The [b]2nd-place team will enter at Survival Stage Day 1[/b], while the teams finishing [b]3rd through 8th will begin their journey in the Qualifying Stage[/b].[/p][p align="start"]This means Circuit 4 is about more than simply breaking into the Top 8. For teams already inside the qualification zone, the battle will continue until the very end as they fight for a higher PGS Points ranking and a more advantageous PGC seed.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]240 PGS Points Are Still Up for Grabs[/b][/p][p align="start"]In both [b]PGS 10 and PGS 11[/b], the winner will earn [b]60 PGS Points[/b], with points awarded down through 16th place.[/p][p align="start"]At the Circuit Final, [b]PGS 12, the points will be doubled[/b]. The winner will earn 120 points, with 96 points going to second place, and double the PGS 10 and PGS 11 point values applied throughout the standings.[/p][p align="start"]That means the maximum number of points a single team can earn in Circuit 4 is:[/p][p align="start"][b]60 points (PGS 10 1st) + 60 points (PGS 11 1st) + 120 points (PGS 12 1st) = 240 points.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Considering the current gaps both inside and outside the PGC qualification zone, the three remaining tournaments leave plenty of room for the final standings to change.[/p][p align="start"]For teams outside the Top 8, Circuit 4 represents one final opportunity to make their move. For those already inside, it will be the final test to defend their position and secure a higher PGC seed.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261012/lwSlSIQk.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][h2][b]PGS 10 Groups[/b][/h2][p align="start"]And it all begins with [b]PGS 10[/b].[/p][p align="start"]The Group Stage groups have been confirmed for the 24 teams competing in PGS 10. The teams have been divided into Groups A, B, and C through a [b]snake seeding format based on the final results of PGS 9.[/b][/p][p align="start"]PGS 9 winner Gen.G Esports has been placed in Group A, second-place T1 in Group B, and third-place Falcons in Group C. From there, the direction of placement alternates according to the PGS 9 standings, distributing all 24 teams across the three groups.[/p][list][*][p][b]Group A:[/b] Gen.G Esports, Made in Thailand, Virtus.pro, TEAM LIQUID, DN SOOPers, Sharper Esports, Team Vitality, Natus Vincere[/p][/*][*][p][b]Group B:[/b] T1, Alpha Gaming, Team Flash, eArena, Petrichor Road, FULL SENSE, TYLOO, JD Gaming[/p][/*][*][p][b]Group C:[/b] Falcons, Geekay Esports, Anyone’s Legend, 17Gaming, FOUR ANGRY MEN, Twisted Minds, 09(Team Nemesis at PGS 9), Godlike[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p align="start"][b]\[Updated: October 12][/b][/p][p align="start"]Following GAM The Expendables’ withdrawal from PGS Circuit 4, Team Flash has been selected as the replacement team based on its placement in PVS Phase 1, in accordance with the existing team qualification criteria.[/p][p align="start"][i]※ Further updates will be provided if there are any changes to the tournament.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][/table][/*][/list][h2][b]The Final Step to PGC[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The 2026 PUBG Global Series journey that began with PGS 1 now has just three tournaments remaining.[/p][p align="start"]There is still everything to play for after Circuit 3. With 60 points available at each of PGS 10 and PGS 11, followed by 120 points at PGS 12, [b]a total of 240 points remain on the table—and a single strong finish could reshape the race to PGC.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Which teams will finish inside the final Top 8 and earn their place at PGC 2026? And which team will rise to the very top of the standings to secure a direct seed to the [b]PGC Grand Finals[/b]?[/p][p align="start"]The final competition of the [b]2026 PUBG Global Series[/b] is about to begin.[/p][p align="start"][b]Tune in and cheer on your favorite teams as they make their final push toward PGC 2026![/b][/p]

[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d897bb630fb567f1b11e928a2b353031645abb21.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare 4[/i] is now live worldwide! In the epic Campaign, Price is on the run, conflict has erupted on the Korean Peninsula, and a catastrophic weapon of war is on the verge of falling into the wrong hands. [/p][p]Deploy across 20 Multiplayer maps at launch, including 12 new 6v6 maps, 4 Gunfight maps, 3 Ground War maps, and the new Kill Block modular training facility. Experience grounded, precise combat built around fluid movement, player choice, and greater control in every engagement. [/p][p]In the DMZ extraction mode, operate as an off-the-books asset behind enemy lines, where every deployment into contested territory forces hard choices about which objectives to pursue, what to secure, and when to get out. [/p][p]Keep reading for all the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launch intel you need, so that you’re fully prepared to kick off an incredible Modern Warfare experience. newsitems.title: PGS 11 Survival Stage is LIVE!!
newsitems.author: JBowlerr
newsitems.contents: [p]Hello, PUBG Esports fans![/p][p align="start"]The final stretch of the 2026 PUBG Global Series is approaching: [b]PGS Circuit 4[/b]. With PGS 10, PGS 11, and the Circuit Final, PGS 12, the three remaining tournaments will bring this year’s 12-event PUBG Global Series to a close.[/p][p align="start"]Circuit 4 is more than just the final circuit of the season. With the conclusion of PGS 12, the [b]final PGS Points standings for the 2026 season will be determined, deciding the eight teams that will advance to PUBG Global Championship 2026.[/b][/p][p align="start"]After three circuits of competition, the race for PGC is beginning to take shape—but nothing has been decided yet. With PGS 10, PGS 11, and double points on the line at PGS 12, there are still [b]240 PGS Points[/b] up for grabs.[/p][p align="start"]Which teams will earn their way to PGC 2026 through PGS Points? Let’s take a closer look at [b]Circuit 4, the final competition of the 2026 PGS season.[/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/QYvMFGPC.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][h2][b]PGS Circuit 4 Schedule[/b][/h2][p align="start"]PGS Circuit 4 will take place from [b]October 14 to November 1[/b].[/p][list][*][p][b]PGS 10[/b][/p][list][*][p]Group Stage: October 14[/p][/*][*][p]Winners Stage: October 15[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Stage: October 16[/p][/*][*][p]Final Stage: October 17–18[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]PGS 11[/b][/p][list][*][p]Winners Stage: October 22[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Stage: October 23[/p][/*][*][p]Final Stage: October 24–25[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]PGS 12[/b][/p][list][*][p]Survival Stage: October 29[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Finals: October 30–November 1[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"]As the [b]Circuit Final[/b], PGS 12 will see the top eight teams in the Circuit 4 PGS Points standings advance directly to the Grand Finals based on the points accumulated through PGS 10 and PGS 11. The remaining 16 teams will compete in the Survival Stage for the remaining spots in the Grand Finals.[/p][p align="start"]When PGS 12 comes to an end, it will mark not only the conclusion of Circuit 4, but also the end of the [b]2026 season-long PGS Points race spanning PGS 1 through PGS 12.[/b][/p][p align="start"][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/dfU4pJIb.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/b] [/p][h2][b]PGS Points Standings[/b][/h2][p align="start"]With three circuits and nine PGS events now complete, the battle for PGS Points is more intense than ever.[/p][p align="start"]At the conclusion of Circuit 3, [b]Virtus.pro leads the standings with 261 points[/b], followed by Made in Thailand with 224 points, 17Gaming with 223 points, and T1 with 208 points.[/p][p align="start"]Currently occupying the final PGC qualification spot is [b]Petrichor Road in eighth place with 152 points.[/b][/p][p align="start"]But the gaps around the cutoff remain narrow. Seventh-place Falcons sit just two points ahead at 154, while ninth-place Gen.G Esports trail the current PGC qualification line by only seven points with 145.[/p][p align="start"]Most importantly, [b]Circuit 4 is still to come.[/b] The current standings are far from the final picture of who will advance to PGC.[/p][p align="start"] [img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/WQDtO1dg.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][h2][b]PGC 2026 Qualification & PGS Points[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The [b]top eight teams in the final PGS Points standings[/b], accumulated across PGS 1 through PGS 12 during the 2026 season, will qualify for PGC 2026.[/p][p align="start"]And the final standings determine more than just qualification. The higher a team finishes in the PGS Points standings, the [b]later the stage from which they will begin their PGC 2026 journey.[/b][/p][p align="start"]The team finishing [b]1st in PGS Points will advance directly to the PGC 2026 Grand Finals[/b]. The [b]2nd-place team will enter at Survival Stage Day 1[/b], while the teams finishing [b]3rd through 8th will begin their journey in the Qualifying Stage[/b].[/p][p align="start"]This means Circuit 4 is about more than simply breaking into the Top 8. For teams already inside the qualification zone, the battle will continue until the very end as they fight for a higher PGS Points ranking and a more advantageous PGC seed.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]240 PGS Points Are Still Up for Grabs[/b][/p][p align="start"]In both [b]PGS 10 and PGS 11[/b], the winner will earn [b]60 PGS Points[/b], with points awarded down through 16th place.[/p][p align="start"]At the Circuit Final, [b]PGS 12, the points will be doubled[/b]. The winner will earn 120 points, with 96 points going to second place, and double the PGS 10 and PGS 11 point values applied throughout the standings.[/p][p align="start"]That means the maximum number of points a single team can earn in Circuit 4 is:[/p][p align="start"][b]60 points (PGS 10 1st) + 60 points (PGS 11 1st) + 120 points (PGS 12 1st) = 240 points.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Considering the current gaps both inside and outside the PGC qualification zone, the three remaining tournaments leave plenty of room for the final standings to change.[/p][p align="start"]For teams outside the Top 8, Circuit 4 represents one final opportunity to make their move. For those already inside, it will be the final test to defend their position and secure a higher PGC seed.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261012/lwSlSIQk.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][h2][b]PGS 10 Groups[/b][/h2][p align="start"]And it all begins with [b]PGS 10[/b].[/p][p align="start"]The Group Stage groups have been confirmed for the 24 teams competing in PGS 10. The teams have been divided into Groups A, B, and C through a [b]snake seeding format based on the final results of PGS 9.[/b][/p][p align="start"]PGS 9 winner Gen.G Esports has been placed in Group A, second-place T1 in Group B, and third-place Falcons in Group C. From there, the direction of placement alternates according to the PGS 9 standings, distributing all 24 teams across the three groups.[/p][list][*][p][b]Group A:[/b] Gen.G Esports, Made in Thailand, Virtus.pro, TEAM LIQUID, DN SOOPers, Sharper Esports, Team Vitality, Natus Vincere[/p][/*][*][p][b]Group B:[/b] T1, Alpha Gaming, Team Flash, eArena, Petrichor Road, FULL SENSE, TYLOO, JD Gaming[/p][/*][*][p][b]Group C:[/b] Falcons, Geekay Esports, Anyone’s Legend, 17Gaming, FOUR ANGRY MEN, Twisted Minds, 09(Team Nemesis at PGS 9), Godlike[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p align="start"][b]\[Updated: October 12][/b][/p][p align="start"]Following GAM The Expendables’ withdrawal from PGS Circuit 4, Team Flash has been selected as the replacement team based on its placement in PVS Phase 1, in accordance with the existing team qualification criteria.[/p][p align="start"][i]※ Further updates will be provided if there are any changes to the tournament.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][/table][/*][/list][h2][b]The Final Step to PGC[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The 2026 PUBG Global Series journey that began with PGS 1 now has just three tournaments remaining.[/p][p align="start"]There is still everything to play for after Circuit 3. With 60 points available at each of PGS 10 and PGS 11, followed by 120 points at PGS 12, [b]a total of 240 points remain on the table—and a single strong finish could reshape the race to PGC.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Which teams will finish inside the final Top 8 and earn their place at PGC 2026? And which team will rise to the very top of the standings to secure a direct seed to the [b]PGC Grand Finals[/b]?[/p][p align="start"]The final competition of the [b]2026 PUBG Global Series[/b] is about to begin.[/p][p align="start"][b]Tune in and cheer on your favorite teams as they make their final push toward PGC 2026![/b][/p]

newsitems.title: PGS 10: The Predator, Virtus.pro
newsitems.author: JBowlerr
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261022/zDWndffP.jpg" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: calc(100% - 10px); position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; vertical-align: bottom; text-align: center;"][/img][/p][p]Until last year, it felt like the era of Twisted Minds. But this year, everything has changed. The arrival of a predator capable of devouring every team in its path has reshaped the PUBG Esports landscape. And that predator emerged not from Asia or APAC, but from Europe. Its name is Virtus.Pro[b] (VP)[/b], the new dominant force in PUBG Esports.[/p][p]​Of course, VP was not yet the finished product in 2025. The team finished as runners-up at PGS 9 and went on to claim the PGS 10 title. However, when it mattered most at PGC 2025, VP once again had to settle for second place. But the VP of 2026 is a different beast. Starting with a championship victory at PGS 3, VP followed up with a runner-up finish at PEC Spring, third place at PGS 5, and a championship title at the Esports World Cup (EWC). The team then secured back-to-back runner-up finishes at PGS 7 and PGS 8, followed by another second-place finish at PEC Fall. And last week, VP claimed yet another championship at PGS 10. VP now holds a commanding lead in the PGS Points standings and has consistently placed among the top teams at major tournaments throughout the year. So, what exactly has made VP so strong?[b]
[img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261022/uYiR8p58.jpg" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: calc(100% - 10px); position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; vertical-align: bottom; text-align: center;"][/img][/b][/p][p]VP’s biggest transformation began in mid-2025. After announcing his retirement as a professional player, ibiza transitioned into a coaching role with VP, while curexi joined the roster to fill the vacant position. Having made his professional debut in 2018, ibiza competed until 2025 and established himself as one of Europe’s most experienced veterans. He had served as VP’s in-game leader (IGL), but decided to take on a new challenge as a coach to help the team reach the next level.[/p][p]​To fill the gap, VP brought in curexi, who had previously played for prominent organizations such as Heroic and FaZe Clan, strengthening the team’s overall balance. As a coach, ibiza began applying the experience and strategic knowledge he had accumulated over his long career, providing tailored preparation for each tournament. Meanwhile, curexi quickly adapted to the existing roster, requiring little time to find his place within the team.[/p][p]​So, what makes this team so formidable? VP has many strengths, but three stand out in particular.[b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261022/ZlUNqPhv.jpg" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: calc(100% - 10px); position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; vertical-align: bottom; text-align: center;"][/img][/b][/p][p]The first is VP’s ability to make quick, accurate decisions under pressure. Lukarux, the team’s IGL, excels at identifying which positions to secure and which routes to take. Even when circumstances change in an instant, he remains composed and makes decisive calls. Whether attacking or defending, his decisions consistently demonstrate remarkable precision and stability. But these decisions do not come from Lukarux alone. In today’s competitive environment, every player must be capable of making independent decisions. At the same time, those individual decisions must align with the team’s overall strategy. Lukarux establishes the bigger picture, while the other three players make real-time adjustments and contribute the finer details needed to execute that strategy.[/p][p]​As we will explore further, VP’s confidence in its fighting ability—and its understanding of which engagements it can win—forms the foundation of its decision-making. This is why VP often takes a far more aggressive approach than other teams. Once VP identifies a target, the team commits its full attention to it. Teams that fall behind in championship races sometimes struggle because they consider too many options at once, losing sight of what matters most at critical moments. VP is different. The team knows exactly what to prioritize when it matters, and more importantly, how to execute the actions required to achieve its objective.[b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261022/HPnI3PFZ.png" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: calc(100% - 10px); position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; vertical-align: bottom; text-align: center;"][/img][/b][/p][p align="start"]​The second strength is VP’s exceptional fighting ability and technical skill. And to explain this, we have to talk about NIXZYEE. If I had to choose just one player with the most formidable fighting ability in 2026, I would pick NIXZYEE without hesitation. He possesses an extraordinary range of combat techniques and movement skills, combining devastating firepower with excellent teamwork.[/p][p]​His precision when spraying with magnified scopes is almost mechanical. His peeks are astonishingly fast, and his unpredictable movement constantly disrupts his opponents’ timing. With his overwhelming individual skill, NIXZYEE turns every engagement into a nightmare for his opponents. Among all active players, it would not be an exaggeration to call him one of the most complete players in the game. What makes him even more frightening is his constant pursuit of improvement. He continues to study new techniques, refine them, and incorporate them into his gameplay.[/p][p]​But NIXZYEE is far from VP’s only threat. Beami and curexi also bring tremendous firepower to long-range engagements, consistently delivering strong performances. They are particularly dangerous when using sniper rifles (SRs), often securing the first knock against an opponent and creating new opportunities for their team to push forward. Their headshot accuracy is especially impressive. While many professional players maintain headshot rates of around 20%, VP’s players frequently exceed 30%. These precise headshots allow them to knock opponents out of position and create opportunities to take control of areas held by enemy teams. These strengths were on full display at PGS 10. Throughout the tournament, VP recorded 55 first knocks, averaging 5.5 per match.[b]
[img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261022/uDD5ZcV0.png" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: calc(100% - 10px); position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; vertical-align: bottom; text-align: center;"][/img][/b][/p][p]VP’s third major strength is its ability to build and execute strategies specifically designed to win championships. Its tactical flexibility goes beyond making adjustments within individual matches. VP also analyzes the overall standings, identifies its closest championship rivals, and develops strategies to directly challenge them when necessary. The final match of PGS 10 on Taego is a perfect example.[/p][p]​At the time, VP was tied on 86 points with tournament leader Team Liquid (TL). Rather than simply following its usual strategy and trying to outscore its rival through conventional play, VP made a bold decision. It chose to directly target TL. This was not a reckless gamble. It was a calculated decision based on VP’s confidence in early-game engagements and its analysis of how TL was likely to respond. And the strategy worked almost immediately. VP eliminated two TL players in an early engagement, gaining a decisive advantage from the start. From there, VP systematically shut down the routes TL could use to move into the playable area, limiting its opportunities to recover and earn additional points. By neutralizing its closest rival, VP took control of the championship race. In the end, the title belonged to VP.[/p][p]​[b]Looking Ahead[/b][/p][p]There is still much more to explore when it comes to VP’s winning formula. But with even greater challenges waiting ahead, it would be a shame to reveal every aspect of their strategy just yet.[/p][p]​The predator of 2026 has already conquered PGS. Can VP go one step further and finally lift the PGC trophy it has been chasing? We’ll be watching closely as the predator prepares for its next hunt.[/p][p]​- Jisooboy[/p]

newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/736fbd2908280146bdce5b8f2be92d2a8a4bb032.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Multiplayer: Launch Maps[/h2][p][/p][p]Modern Warfare 4 launches with 12 Core 6v6 maps (plus Shipment arriving shortly after launch on October 27), three large-scale 32v32 Ground War maps, four 2v2 Gunfight maps, and the modular battleground, Kill Block, supporting 3v3 and 10v10 Gunfight.[/p][p]Here’s a look at all of the maps, including Tac-Map displays for each of the Core 6v6 and Ground War 32v32 maps:[/p][p][/p][h3]Core 6v6 Maps[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Cachette[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ce5ada6d0fe9254ca29a12af7b711fbec9f0f621.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]On the outskirts of a French rail terminal, an abandoned wine warehouse and derelict mechanic’s garage have been converted into a covert armory.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/cachette"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Coal[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4e9a35c482d83fbeffe74b82d054f2c2fe35f36e.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]Fight through the remains of an old Soviet coal processing plant in a remote, mountainous area, complete with a fallen smokestack, ore chutes, and processing buildings feeding into a slurry-filled river and polluted flood plain. [/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/coal"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Lithium[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/428b78a8396fe9ee9074edc879eeb439c61d8500.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]Deep within a rural Mexican state beneath the Sierra Mountains, Corporación Mexicana de Litio’s Lithium processing refinery has come under attack, transforming the site into an active combat zone.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/lithium"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Lotus[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d4eec0bc52414a74c4d42967501cb811f527f1fd.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]A South Korean fishing village in the aftermath of an amphibious assault, its market, hostel, boathouse, gardens, and residential blocks left scarred by the fight to reclaim it.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/lotus"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Mumbai[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7c8c4ebe69457272587045fe9ade623ac3248480.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]A fugitive’s hideout hidden inside a dense residential district centered around a Victorian market, with a rail line cutting through tightly packed residential blocks. [/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/mumbai"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Munition[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/05f4edd8882ee4ab23c063a9fa1e68a2892fc8fb.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]An active North Korean command facility with a large munitions depot, monitoring rooms, a linked skybridge, crane, water tower, and multiple hangars.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/munition"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Nautical[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/428c3eb3724cb0be2f15975bc7b5dbd1add2fc9c.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]At dawn, a South Korean ferry pulls away from a major conflict zone as debris litters the decks and fires burn across the starboard side and bow.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/nautical"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Reactor U92[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/963d464860567fd35cd613111fb69144a086bc9f.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]A South Korean reactor complex has gone nuclear. Electrical damage arcs across the large concave command room, while the boiling containment pool appears to be the epicenter of a massive meltdown.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/reactor-u92"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Rooftops[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d02cc7d116337cf134f3f1dd46dcc8ddfdf9dbbd.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]The snow-lined rooftops of New York’s “Hotel Times West” create combat opportunities across a rooftop greenhouse, HVAC platforms, boiler room, patio, skylights, pigeon coop, and laundry room.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/rooftops"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Sentry[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fab6c69e6998ce6ee6bd7b105609d773c1061af9.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]An assault on a Russian military base under whiteout conditions sparks firefights across the maintenance garage, generator room, and substation surrounding a central command center and partly destroyed barracks.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/sentry"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Silkworm[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e7b9a363d9173b3b25a3b5e0d8284c48372edc0d.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]Infiltrate a dense, urban South Korean shopping district with alley access around perimeter apartments, as the action centers on a well-stocked convenience store, gaming den, and central subway entrance.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/silkworm"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Transit 213[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3f427988aa6174cad1dcc6c046db9ca03cf6764a.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]An overgrown central parking lot in western India packed with brightly colored buses in various states of dereliction, flanked by a repair shop and small gas station and surrounded by construction projects and high-rise tenement blocks.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/transit-213"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Shipment[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/007321b1f9ada0e5b26475883c890b859306f811.jpg"][/img][i]Post-Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]Shipment returns! Arriving shortly after launch on October 27, the infamous small map is set on a Russian harbor, hemmed in between the water and the concrete panel buildings making up the urban landscape around it. The map itself is true to form with a classic layout and appearance that players will be right at home with, enhanced by Modern Warfare 4’s visual and gameplay improvements.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Ground War 32v32 Maps[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Imjin Farmland[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/548cc5596f9cf48ca78391e975e9a06a65070c72.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 32v32[/i][/p][p]Battle across the rural outskirts of Hajin, where open fields, waterways, scattered farms, and the large-scale mill combine with roads and rail lines to create a combat zone suited to long sightlines, vehicle maneuvering, and coordinated assaults on key strongholds.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Wolves Stadium[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6e69fe588f0d2a2970e5c17b9a2cb770cbc14e76.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 32v32[/i][/p][p]Fight through the heart of Hajin in a dense urban environment centered on the Wolves Stadium. Multi-story buildings, transit lines, tunnels, rooftops, and surrounding hillsides create a highly versatile arena of battle where every route offers multiple ways to advance.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Forest[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0da9a3802544a7852591e81349f81fe7d685102d.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 32v32[/i][/p][p]Positioned between the Imjin Farmlands and Wolves Stadium, Forest challenges Operators to battle over and around a wooded hillside. A network of streets, off-road paths, and the southern train tracks provide room for vehicles to navigate the area, while points of interest like the guard tower at the top of the hill, the gas station, and the barracks mark key objective points that can be used to defend against unseen attackers behind the tree line.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Gunfight 2v2 Maps[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Cafe[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a6d557a51db6c0c7a3fc0823d819681f314164e3.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 2v2[/i][/p][p]Deploy to a scenic courtyard in Paris featuring a theater, magazine kiosk, and a central fountain that blocks views down the middle. Climb up to the statue on top for a better view or try your luck on the outer perimeter where there’s sparse cover but longer sightlines.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Library[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/68eef23e20554e30951933bed67f6cfa2e070ce3.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 2v2[/i][/p][p]Disturb the peace in this wood paneled state library that packs tactical opportunities into a tight space. Watch for enemies lurking behind bookshelves and rushing through the center. Take the stairs to get up on the center walkway with views over both sides of the map.[/p][p][/p][p][b]NYC[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1420295e9cf512fd9157c947c16ad7ef4ab176ca.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 2v2[/i][/p][p]Pack warm for a wintry night in the thick of downtown. A large stage dominates the center surrounded by stands, equipment, and vendors. Weave between objects on the ground to flank enemies or climb up to one of the many scattered vantage points throughout.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Smuggler[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c3234a743497b3dd6dd562ac5988e4ead6c478ba.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 2v2[/i][/p][p]Take the fight to a rail yard where several train cars are parked on the tracks. Battle in, around, and on top of them with ladders giving access to the roof. For a closer fight, head into the warehouse on either side or move out to the ends where there’s more open space to move around.[/p][p][/p][h3]Kill Block[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/70bd4ae169e55e582fe8a995ee339c10250054a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Launch Map · 3v3 / 10v10[/i][/p][p]The Westbridge Training Facility — AKA Kill Block — is a modular Multiplayer battleground featuring reconfiguring combat layouts. Designed as a live-fire training environment, Kill Block reconfigures between rounds, forcing players to reassess sightlines, routes, and combat spaces. With more than 500 combinations, no two Kill Block deployments play out the same.[/p][p]Some map sections are entirely new, while others draw inspiration from iconic locations across Modern Warfare history including Crash, Highrise, and Shoot House, appearing in randomized placements each match. Supports 3v3 and 10v10 Gunfight at launch.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Multiplayer: Launch Modes[/h2][p][/p][p]Play over a dozen Multiplayer modes at launch, including a variety of Standard, Alternate, and Hardcore variants, plus a Mobility Course designed to help you master the Modern Warfare 4 movement system.[/p][p][b]NOTE:[/b] Hardcore rules include a limited HUD, friendly fire, and reduced health with no regeneration.[/p][p] [/p][p]The available game modes at launch include:[/p][p][/p][h3]Respawn Modes[/h3][p][/p][p][b]New Mode: Inflation[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bb6bae90932ce61f52df4eded37a7f2ba981283a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bbcd2ed239d32708c512fc6fc390a17c2d18a4b9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · Hardcore[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 10 Minutes · Score Limit: N/A · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]Eliminate enemies and collect their bounty of cash, but the more wealth you carry, the greater the target on your back. Players who reach the High Value Target threshold will have their position revealed to friends and foes alike, turning Inflation into a balance of hunting down enemy HVTs while protecting your own. [/p][p]Eliminated players drop a portion of their cash, with an Overtime that activates in the final minutes setting up bigger cash multipliers for wild late game swings. The team with the most cash at the end wins.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Mode: Hijack[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ff95f4460f563db770ef2102c5ceaa3d0e33a71e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/968b15266e051ebd4e4d63f1ccceace45bde6a55.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · Hardcore[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 4 Minutes per Round · Score Limit: 300 · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]Teams fight for control of a single Data Spike that they can carry, throw, and pass to teammates on the way to the enemy Comm Station. Plant the Spike to score points over time and earn a bonus if the upload is completed, requiring a sustained defense of the area after planting to prevent the enemy from aborting the data transfer.[/p][p]Teams swap sides between rounds and the Data Spike occasionally resets to the center when dropped and not picked up in time, when the spike is thrown out of bounds, or after a successful defuse.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Frontline[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3cfe4c95fb5fc2ea04f2848f41a1736882db4f26.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 10 Minutes · Score Limit: 100 · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]Push the line in this team-based respawn mode where players always deploy from their team’s base. Eliminate enemies to score, with eliminations earned outside of the base counting for more, encouraging teams to push forward and spread out through the map. Players gain a small window of invincibility after spawning and teams change sides once one team earns half of the max score limit. The first team to reach the score limit wins.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Team Deathmatch[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1465e4fb6dadd15680833394b0a8bb2fced7471d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f5c9adab750e9aa13c280ef6b72408882d345f69.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · Hardcore[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 10 Minutes · Score Limit: 100 · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]Eliminate enemy players until the score limit is reached to win.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Domination[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4ed9a90f3f33bc131bb2a5db52366360a62e9845.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · Hardcore[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: Unlimited · Score Limit: 200 · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]Capture, hold, and defend objectives to earn points. First team to the score limit wins.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Hardpoint[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0ef953f41106d7b147b4f4e154b92cde59e332ea.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/704f0d61634e1842b96558977cb661cd5235334a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · Hardcore[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 5 Minutes · Score Limit: 250 · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]Capture the rotating Hardpoint and hold it against attack. The first team to reach the score limit wins.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Kill Confirmed[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/43e4770f5368d1aa78288e835494ead38f490259.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a85c70c087960fb073fd0eab219994e73925f5c1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · Hardcore[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 10 Minutes · Score Limit: 75 · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]Recover dog tags to score for your team and deny enemy scores.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Free-For-All[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/10c213107c27f16344891c0c6067a1a88a5fa6e1.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f0a6b7561242c75522be98dc41c4dd8a285a6c9b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · Hardcore[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 10 Minutes · Score Limit: 30 · Party Size: 1[/i][/p][p]Eliminate everyone. The first player to reach the score limit ends the game. The top three players win.[/p][p][/p][h3]Round-Based Tactical Modes[/h3][p][/p][p][b]New Mode: Collateral[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1755a1fa1a6f6db40d251b2eaafa4ab872d8fe1c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/200b37591fabd3b18903332bfee476414473e131.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 2 Minutes per Round · Score Limit: 6 · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]Start with a Pistol and $800 and earn extra cash to spend on better gear between rounds in this exciting new mode blending Search & Destroy mechanics with a Buy Phase system that lets players improve their loadouts as the match progresses. Teams alternate between attacking and defending two bomb sites, and the better you do, the more cash you’ll earn to spend during the pre-round Buy Phase. Get rewarded for planting and defusing bombs, eliminating players — with varying levels of payout for different kinds of kills — and winning the round.[/p][p]There are no respawns and no custom loadouts. When you die, you lose your loadout and start over, but you keep the cash you’ve earned. The Buy Menu features the following options, including the ability for teams to pitch in for a UAV going into the next round: [/p][p][/p][p][b]Armor and Perks:[/b] Armor Vest, Battle Hardened, Lethal Reach, Fast Hands, Ghost[/p][p][b]Equipment:[/b] Flash Grenade, Molotov Cocktail, Frag Grenade, Stim, Smoke Wall, Riot Shield[/p][p][b]Pistols:[/b] Krait P68 Silenced Pistol, Mojave .357Revolver, Sang 9mm Akimbo Pistols, .50 GS Power Pistol[/p][p][b]Standard Issue:[/b] Rezi 12 Shotgun, FiNN Light Machine Gun, Oris 8.6 Marksman Rifle, X-58 Nyx Silenced SMG, Wz. 55 Striga Agile SMG[/p][p][b]Tier 1:[/b] MAR-9 Marksman Rifle, Kastov 762 High Damage Rifle, Hyeon Burst Assault Rifle, M4 Silenced Rifle, KG-7 Vulcan Sniper Rifle[/p][p][b]Team Buy:[/b] UAV[/p][p][/p][p]When purchasing new weapons, drop some extra cash for an upgrade, adding the displayed attachments to the weapon to further improve its lethality.[/p][p]Every dollar counts and every decision matters. The first team to take six rounds wins the match.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Search & Destroy[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/50ad9ca056f7d6f9df53007409f27315a41a6c80.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a9adc810a4fbcab5fdf329e7f8da46d50b9d8235.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · Hardcore[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 2 Minutes per Round · Score Limit: 6 · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]The classic high-stakes, round-based tactical game mode where teams alternate between attacking and defending two bomb sites. There are no respawns here, turning every encounter into a high-tension fight. Win the round by planting or defusing the bomb, or alternately by eliminating the entire enemy team. [/p][p]Planting and defusing the bomb leaves the acting Operator defenseless for several seconds, so bring backup and plan your objective plays accordingly. The first team to win six rounds wins the match. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Gunfight[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/602179c60a773acd0b9a0a5c8bf64cbca22e3da5.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f4a06749359ffd7ea737a77f78ed842a017321b1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · 2v2 / 3v3 / 10v10[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 50 Seconds per Round · Score Limit: 6 · Party Size: 2, 3 or 10[/i][/p][p]Eliminate the enemy or secure the Overtime Flag. All Operators begin each round with the same Loadout which changes every two rounds. The first side to reach the round limit wins the match.[/p][p][/p][h3]Ground War[/h3][p][/p][p][b]New Mode: Combat Outpost[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cc13ff3106edd3006c1ccc78e21519aff8ec671d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Alternate Mode · Core[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 20 Minutes · Score Limit: 1500 · Party Size: 4, 32v32[/i][/p][p]Combat Outpost reimagines Domination for Ground War, expanding the familiar three-flag battle into a large-scale conflict across a sprawling battleground. Capture Outposts to earn a steady stream of points while expanding your team's available spawn locations, allowing friendly forces to reinforce the front line and maintain pressure across the map.[/p][p]The battle doesn't end once an Outpost is secured. Operators can reinforce captured positions to unlock increasingly powerful team rewards, from Local UAV coverage and a JLTV airdrop to a Light Tank delivered straight to your Headquarters. With Capture and Reinforce objectives often overlapping, Combat Outpost rewards teams who can seize territory, defend key positions, and leverage heavy ordinance.[/p][p][/p][h3]Party Mode[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Gun Game[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/63a8a2d51f55a9515b23d525b24243c8711fbcbb.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Alternate Mode · Core[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 10 Minutes · Score Limit: 15 · Party Size: 1[/i][/p][p]Eliminate players with your weapons to advance to the next weapon. First to eliminate with each weapon wins.[/p][p][/p][h3]Proving Grounds[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c479e854f14c52491fa1664e1bcfe9bb7d90bd8b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8d7d1ef53233f772ef39259e045dda5b2c9c307f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Launch[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Master the Modern Warfare 4 movement system in the Proving Grounds, a dedicated training course that will guide you through movement Tutorials and timed Courses. Strive for an S Rating in every Course and take those skills into Multiplayer, turning you into a formidable force before you’ve even played your first match.[/p][p][/p][h3]Pre-Season 1 Modes[/h3][p][/p][p]Plus, look out for two extra Multiplayer modes arriving just in time for Halloween in the leadup to Season 1, including:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Possession (Pre-Season 1)[/b][/p][p][i]New Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7b748870b24afb66c27e4ed668354c3744566b0a.png"][/img][/p][p]For the Halloween season, Possession is a fast, visceral party mode moshpit. Eliminate enemy players to possess them, transmigrating to their location and stealing their Loadout. Eliminate enemies to fly across the map to get on the Hardpoint, or to clear a Search and Destroy bombsite. But beware, you’ll always possess an eliminated enemy, so check your targets before committing to the kill.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Infected (Pre-Season 1)[/b][/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ae73b11a2a270fc7f4a110a9c3d74c66785553e3.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s Survivors vs. the Infected in this team-based party mode where one player is randomly assigned to the Infected team at the start of the match. Every time the Infected player eliminates a Survivor, that player joins the swarm of the Infected. If you’re Infected, eliminate as many as you can to bolster your ranks. If you’re a Survivor, hold out as long as you can against the hordes of Infected.[/p][p][/p][h2]Pre-order Modern Warfare 4 Today[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d8552fbf1ab798421881202c8cc076c85f00aad5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Stay tuned to the latest official [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] information by checking the [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog"]Call of Duty Blog[/url] through launch and beyond.[/p][p][/p][p]Pre-orders are [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4435490/Call_of_Duty_Modern_Warfare_4/"]available now on Steam[/url].[/p]

newsitems.title: Bungie раскроет планы по возвращению контента в Destiny 2 на следующей неделе
newsitems.contents:
Bungie продолжает работать над возвращением контента, удалённого из Destiny 2 за прошедшие годы. Ранее компания заявила, что «не собирается останавливаться» и намерена сохранить наследие франшизы, начав с восстановления всего, что было убрано из игры.

Как сообщает TheGamePost, Джош Дин ответил игрокам в X, отметив, что команда «планирует выпустить обновление» о процессе разблокировки контента на следующей неделе. В предыдущем посте он признал, что у сообщества могут возникнуть вопросы о разблокировке, потенциальных будущих обновлениях Destiny 2 и о том, что ждёт франшизу в целом.

По словам Дина, процесс будет «очень продуманным», а о первом этапе расскажут ближе к концу октября. Он также уточнил, что предстоящее обновление не будет традиционной дорожной картой — вместо этого информацию представят в виде «индикатора прогресса». Цель — приблизить сообщество к этапам разработки, чётко обозначить возникающие проблемы и предоставить игрокам наглядные доказательства проделанной работы.

Точную дату публикации сообщения Джош Дин не назвал.

see.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Progression: Level Unlocks[/h3][p][i]Career / Progression / MP Level Unlocks[/i][/p][p][i]Earn XP to progress through 55 Levels, unlocking Weapons, Equipment, Perks, Killstreaks, and more.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]A Note on DMZ[/b][/p][p]In [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], DMZ features its own distinct Level Unlock progression track that is separate from the Level 1-55 Multiplayer progression system. As players earn DMZ XP by completing Story Missions, Dynamic Operations, Side Ops, and other activities, they will progress through 70 levels, unlocking DMZ-specific rewards along the way including new Gear and Stations, Station Upgrades, 3D Printer Recipes, Operator Skins, Consumables, Fire Support (Killstreaks), Survival Kits, and more.[/p][p]XP earned while playing DMZ also contributes to your overall 1-55 Player Progression, but XP earned in Multiplayer or [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone[/i]™ does not contribute to your DMZ Level.[/p][p]For more information on DMZ progression, check out our in-depth article, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/714540659097208825"]How to Play DMZ, Part 2: Tour of Duty — Forward Operating Base[/url], as well as the complete DMZ Progression Appendix at the end of this blog.[/p][p][/p][h3]Leveling Up: From Private to Commander[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d1378f146f95ca5fca3eae234090cf7150b17c0b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The first step in your [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] journey begins with a simple goal: climb through the military designations from Private I (Level 1) to Commander (Level 55) by earning XP across Multiplayer, DMZ, and starting in Season 1, Call of Duty: Warzone.[/p][p]Earn XP by playing matches and eliminating enemies, playing the objective, and completing challenges. Each level unlocks foundational rewards that expand your Loadout options with new gear and tactical options so you can further home in on the content that works best for your style of play.[/p][p]As you progress through the military ranks, you’ll unlock the following types of content: [/p][p][/p][p][b]Multiplayer Player Level Unlocks[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Unlocks:[/b] Expect one or more unlocks every time you level up, from Level 1-55[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Loadouts:[/b] Default and Custom[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Weapons:[/b] Primary and Secondary Weapons[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Equipment:[/b] Lethals and Tacticals[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Field Upgrades[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Perks[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Killstreaks[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Call of Duty: Warzone Integration Note:[/b] [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Level Unlocks will become accessible in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] when Season 1 releases shortly after launch.[/p][p][/p][p][b]DMZ Player Level Unlocks[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5c54e9ab7a8f5177a0ee8809cd95aae181159a23.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Unlocks:[/b] Expect one or more unlocks every time you level up, from Level 1-70[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Station Unlocks:[/b] Access new Stations within the FOB[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Station Upgrades:[/b] Unlock additional capabilities across various Stations within the FOB. Further Station upgrades can be accessed via the 3D Printer.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Recipes:[/b] Craft new items at the 3D Printer[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Operator Skins[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Items:[/b] Unlock the following Items:[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Consumables[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Survival Kits[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Fire Support (Killstreaks)[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]3D Printer Materials[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Gear[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level Unlocks Appendix:[/b] For a complete list of every piece of content you’ll unlock while leveling up, see the Multiplayer and DMZ Level Unlocks Appendices at the end of this article.[/p][p][/p][h2]Prestige[/h2][p][i]Career / Progression / Prestige[/i] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0a79e67bf239c3391265c06b8049d8c84456ae8a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] offers 10 levels of Prestige and 1,000 Prestige Master levels. For the first time in a Call of Duty game, players can now choose from two distinct Prestige paths: Classic Prestige and Regular Prestige.[/p][p][/p][h3]Classic and Regular Prestige[/h3][p]Whether you prefer the traditional reset-and-rebuild structure of Classic Prestige or a more flexible progression path that preserves unlocked content, both systems deliver long-term rewards, progression milestones, and new ways to level up across Multiplayer and beyond.[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p][b]Classic Prestige[/b] delivers the traditional Prestige experience, resetting level unlocks and Create-a-Class progress in exchange for a 20% XP boost, one Permanent Unlock Token, and bonus cosmetic rewards.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Regular Prestige[/b] allows players to restart progression from Level 1 while keeping all level unlocks and Create-a-Class content intact, offering a more flexible progression path.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/786da5701dd750aac2d170733f7b8a5699a0db5d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Upon completing Level 55, you are given the option to choose your Prestige path. Each time you complete a new Prestige Level, you are given the option again to select either the Classic or Regular Track when entering the next Prestige Level.[/p][p]A majority of the Prestige rewards are shared by both Prestige paths, though players on the Classic Track will earn bonus rewards.[/p][p][/p][h3]Permanent Unlocks[/h3][p]Players who select the Classic Prestige Track will earn one Permanent Unlock Token that allows you to permanently unlock a single Level Unlock item of your choice from the available Loadout items.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/25f4c2af0286f891939065d0aa1ac298190ec0bb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For example, a player enters Prestige 1, having earned a Permanent Unlock Token for selecting the Classic Track. Because their rank is reset to 1, they will have to reach Level 48 again to re-unlock the Throwing Knife. Or they can choose to spend their Permanent Unlock Token on the Throwing Knife, keeping it accessible to them throughout the remainder of their entire leveling journey, even if (and when) they enter Classic Prestige again in the future.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Note:[/b] When choosing which progression item to spend a Permanent Unlock Token on, consider prioritizing Perks, Field Upgrades, Killstreaks, and Equipment over Weapons. Whenever you acquire a Weapon Blueprint from the Store or in a seasonal Battle Pass, the base version of the weapon will become permanently available throughout your entire leveling journey.[/p][p][/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4 Prestige 1 Revealed[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ed68c21edebd15b68533f558397797884f42467f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], each Prestige Level features content inspired by a different Infinity Ward title. See the Loading Screen reward in each Prestige Level progression track to see that Prestige Level’s point of reference.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7ea5178c59ebe601cc5bd5a67fbaebe0dbd69fb6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Prestige 1 kicks things off where it all began with rewards inspired by the original [i]Call of Duty[/i] (2003):[/p][p][/p][p][b]Sandstorm[/b][/p][p][i]Operator Skin for Army SF Airborne[/i][/p][p][i]Unlocked at Prestige 1 Instant Reward[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Call of Duty (2003)[/b][/p][p][i]Loading Screen[/i][/p][p][i]Unlocked at Prestige 1 Level 10[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Prestige 1[/b][/p][p][i]Emblem[/i][/p][p][i]Unlocked at Prestige 1 Level 20[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Engage![/b][/p][p][i]Weapon Charm[/i][/p][p][i]Unlocked at Prestige 1 Level 30[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Men of Service[/b][/p][p][i]Large Decal[/i][/p][p][i]Unlocked at Prestige 1 Level 40[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]The Vet / The Vet Prime[/b][/p][p][i]Weapon Blueprint for the Mosin-Nagant Marksman Rifle[/i][/p][p][i]Regular Track: “The Vet” | Classic Track: “The Vet Prime”[/i][/p][p][i]Unlocked at Prestige 1 Level 50[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4 Prestige 2-10[/h3][p]For those committed to the grind with the goal of entering Prestige Master, you’ll first need to climb through all ten Prestige Levels, each one offering a new reward every ten levels. The following notes highlights from each Prestige Level, including the title that inspires each and the final rewards earned in both the Regular and Classic Tracks:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ab97845d3746863f97be59fd296b148879610688.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Prestige 2: Call of Duty 2 (2005)[/b][/p][p][i]Weapon Blueprints for the PPSh-41 SMG[/i][/p][p][i]Regular Track: “Calm Resolve” | Classic Track: “Trench Fiend”[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Prestige 3: Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (2007)[/b][/p][p][i]Operator Skins for SAS[/i][/p][p][i]Regular Track: “Watchtower” src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fb679218ea492999058624cae09fa99d9221029e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For the hardened vets who manage to progress through all 10 Prestige Levels, the ultimate challenge awaits: Prestige Master. From here on out, your Level will reach beyond 55 all the way to Level 1,000. Earn Prestige Master rewards every five to ten Levels up to Level 99 and then unlock additional rewards every 25 Levels until you reach Level 1,000 and become a Prestige Legend.[/p][p]Expect the Prestige Master rewards you can expect to earn along the way to include the following:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b4912c53b6f34a5559d7a156dd45a7bcc7f92b63.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Prestige Master Instant Reward[/b][/p][p][i]Prestige Master Highlight: “Paragon” Operator Skin | Park[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Other rewards in the Level 56-99 Prestige Master track include:[/p][list][*][p]Prestige Master Instant Reward: Orange Level Color[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Prestige Master Level 60: “Best of the Best” Loading Screen[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Prestige Master Level 65: “Prestige Master 56” Emblem[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Prestige Master Level 70: “Pinnacle” Weapon Charm[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Prestige Master Level 80: “Containment Breach” Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Prestige Master Level 90: “Master Renegade” Han 86 Assault Rifle Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Prestige Master Level Colors[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9c314dd52b1a459d20a1a63b012fb5902f0b4d2a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Upon entering Prestige Master at Level 56, players will earn their first Level Color customization option, starting with Orange, allowing you to customize your Level Color for other players to see in-game.[/p][p]Reach Level 100 to acquire the Navy option, with more Level Color options unlocking every 25 Prestige Master Levels, including multi-color and animated color options.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Prestige Master Icons[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/92206514e0ea07926d631336f3f235e71a43f8d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Beginning at Prestige Master Level 100, and every 100 Levels thereafter on the way to Prestige Legend, players will unlock additional sets of legacy Prestige icons from past Call of Duty games across the entire franchise, including the new Modern Warfare 4 Prestige icons. Equipping one of these Legacy Prestige Icons replaces your current Prestige Master icon.[/p][p]The ultimate rewards for reaching Prestige Legend? Those are \[CLASSIFIED].[/p][p][/p][h2]Weapon Camos[/h2][p][i]Create a Class / Edit Custom Class / Camo Select[/i][/p][p][i]Unlock Camos that can be equipped to your Loadout Weapons in Gunsmith.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0f9920c4a3111c5a9ceff014c42b8ea137cc5611.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], Weapon Camo progress begins with the basics: level up your weapon. Whether you’re playing Multiplayer or DMZ (and starting at Season 1, [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]), you’ll begin working your way toward unlocking the initial Military Camos. By tying these Camos to your Weapon Level, you are rewarded no matter what your playstyle.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tip:[/b] Get an early start on the Weapon Camo grind with the release of DMZ Early Access on October 20 for digital pre-orders and pre-purchases! Level up your weapons and earn Attachments and Camos that will be available in Multiplayer at the game’s official launch on October 23.[/p][p][/p][h3]Military Camos[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/64799f0448770cb5e13ad603ec5f6b6de6b754f4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every weapon begins its Camo journey with the Military Camos. There are eight Military Camos in all, each one unlocked sequentially at escalating Weapon Level milestones. Because the Military Camos are tied to Weapon Level, they must be individually unlocked on each weapon. The required Weapon Level to unlock the different Military Camos varies between each weapon, taking its Max maximum Weapon Level into account.[/p][p]Each weapon has individual unlock access to the same eight Military Camos, numbered 1 through 8 (Military Camo 1, Military Camo 2, etc.). As long as you’re using the weapon, you benefit from unlocking Military Camos, granting greater flexibility in how you approach the early Camo grind.[/p][p][/p][p]For example:[/p][p][b]Han 86 Assault Rifle Military Camo Unlock Criteria.[/b] This occurs no matter which game mode you are playing (Multiplayer or DMZ), and you accrue Military Camos as you level up the weapon between 1 and 72. Other weapons have different unlock levels.[/p][list][*][p][b]Military Camo 1:[/b] Reach Weapon Level 10.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Military Camo 2:[/b] Reach Weapon Level 18.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Military Camo 3:[/b] Reach Weapon Level 25.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Military Camo 4:[/b] Reach Weapon Level 34.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Military Camo 5:[/b] Reach Weapon Level 42.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Military Camo 6:[/b] Reach Weapon Level 50.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Military Camo 7:[/b] Reach Weapon Level 57.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Military Camo 8:[/b] Reach Weapon Level 65.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Special Camos[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3d843f9a67e575eb82062d810d19b9d8dec02bb1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Each weapon additionally features three Special Weapon Camos that are unique to every weapon, and once completed, join a universal pool of Camos accessible to all other weapons. Reach the required Weapon Level to gain access to the Special Camo Challenges, tasking you with combat-specific objectives like landing a certain number of double kills, mounted kills, longshots, headshots, and other gameplay challenges.[/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] features a single Weapon Camo grind that is shared across all modes, and the Special Camo Challenges will automatically adjust to the specific mode you are playing. Because non-player targets count in DMZ, Special Camo Challenges typically require a higher kill count in that extraction mode compared to Multiplayer or Call of Duty: Warzone. Once you complete the challenge in any mode, the Special Camo will be available in all modes. Play the mode of your choosing and get rewarded.[/p][p][/p][p]Two examples:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c8e530bc1c4bf685741763f76cf857c4b3346a3a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Han 86 Assault Rifle Special Camo Unlock Criteria:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Smoke:[/b] Get player kills while the weapon is Mounted. Challenge unlocked at Weapon Level 25.[/p][list][*][p]20 Kills for Multiplayer.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]75 Kills for DMZ.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Stormwave:[/b] Get player kills while using a silencer. Challenge unlocked at Weapon Level 46.[/p][list][*][p]50 Kills for Multiplayer.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]125 Enemy Kills in DMZ.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Red:[/b] Get player kills with a specific criteria, depending on the mode.. Challenge unlocked at Weapon Level 72 (Max Weapon Level for the Han 86).[/p][list][*][p]3 Player Kills without dying for Multiplayer.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]3 Enemy Kills without taking damage 50 times for DMZ.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Sang 9mm Pistol Special Camo Unlock Criteria:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Autumn:[/b] Get player kills while Aiming Down Sights. newsitems.title: Team Fortress 2 Update Released
newsitems.author: erics
newsitems.contents:
An update to Team Fortress 2 has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Team Fortress 2. The major changes include:

[list]
[*]Fixed some maps not tracking play time correctly
[*]Fixed alpha channel for the updated Cozy Camper backpack image
[*]Updated cp_holyhell[list]
[*]Fixed BLU side skybox not rendering for users with HDR enabled
[*]Improved RED side art pass
[*]Improved middle point art pass
[*]Spells get enabled and respawn permanently on the side of the team that loses middle. This can go both ways.
[*]Lowered round timer to 5 minutes
[*]After 5 minutes of any team capturing middle, instead of a stalemate, every spell gets turned into a rare variant and respawn extremely quickly. After a point gets captured in the stalemate state, the spells return back to normal.
[*]Lowered respawn wave times
[*]Gargoyles now only spawn near middle
[*]Better optimization[/list]
[*]Updated Updated zi_atoll, zi_blazehattan, zi_devastation_final1, zi_murky, zi_sanitarium, and zi_woods[list]
[*]Fixed player models being invisible in dx8
[*]Fixed tiling HUD icon for Heal ability
[*]Fixed bad number display in the "Auto-spawn" text in the spawn picker
[*]Updated Zombie Engineer's Beacon[list]
[*]Instead of instantly breaking, beacons inside of tight spaces will now place themselves in the closest valid location
[*]Fixed thrown toolboxes appearing offcenter
[*]Thrown toolboxes now break upon touching all clip brushes if they can't find a nearby valid location[/list]
[*]Zombie Sniper Spit cooldown changed from 9 seconds to 6 seconds
[*]Updated Zombie Pyro[list]
[*]Increased Zombie Pyro's melee damage from 45 to 65
[*]Sticky Spew now applies a 20% movement slow 
[*]Standing on puddles of sticky spew applies an additional 20% movement slow
[*]Sticky spew puddles are now larger
[*]Spewed Demoman shield movement slow changed from -60% to -70%
[*]Humans covered in sticky spew are now tinted purple instead of black
[*]Zombie Pyro's death explosion now deals 50 damage, applies afterburn, and turns themself and victims to ash[/list]
[*]Fixed Zombie Heavy exploding into rock gibs when not holding a rock
[*]Fixed the Homewrecker not being able to destroy EMP grenades
[*]Updated Zombie Demoman charge kill icon
[*]Changed Zombie melee impact sounds into fists instead of the sloppy wet Unarmed Combat
[*]Fixed Zombie Spy dealing more damage than intended
[*]Fixed queue events with some zombie abilities
[*]Fixed Zombies sometimes moving slowly after casting an ability[/list]
[/list]

newsitems.title: Valve ускорила перезарядку AUG в Counter-Strike 2 и исправила ошибки на картах Rush в свежем обновлении
newsitems.contents:
Valve выпустила небольшое обновление для Counter-Strike 2 от 9 октября. Патч затронул баланс оружия, звуковые эффекты и геометрию карт, а также принёс несколько технических исправлений. Размер загрузки составил около 539 МБ.

Главное изменение касается AUG: время перезарядки винтовки сократили на полсекунды. Такая корректировка может повлиять на поведение оружия в перестрелках, хотя сама по себе не означает масштабного пересмотра его баланса. Кроме того, разработчики добавили специальный значок для выброшенных наборов сапёра, чтобы их было проще заметить на карте.

Valve также исправила ошибку со звуковым событием при бесшумной перезарядке Desert Eagle. Ещё одно исправление касается просмотра демок: теперь не должны возникать гудящие фоновые звуки. Помимо этого, разработчики продолжили устранять проблемы с геометрией на картах режима Rush, обновили локализацию и внесли улучшения в стабильность игры.

Предыдущий небольшой патч для CS2 вышел 6 октября. Тогда Valve добавила кнопки управления загруженными картами из Мастерской, обновила локализованные элементы фотокниги питомцев и скорректировала параметры кэша шейдеров VK. Новое обновление продолжает серию точечных улучшений без крупных изменений игрового процесса.

newsitems.title: Игрок в Counter-Strike 2 написал магистерскую диссертацию о том, как выследить и навсегда избавиться от читера
newsitems.contents:
Простой студент и заядлый игрок в Counter-Strike 2 под ником magga_ защитил целую магистерскую диссертацию в Норвежском университете естественных и технических наук, предложив новый подход к борьбе с нечестными пользователями. Его работа посвящена системе поведенческой биометрии, которая позволяет вычислять реальную личность игрока по микромоторике рук и связывать баны с человеком, а не с его учетной записью Steam.

Главной уязвимостью современных античитов геймер назвал блокировку конкретных аккаунтов. Получив бан, реальный нарушитель просто покупает или регистрирует новый аккаунт и возвращается на серверы со своими читами. Разработанный алгоритм анализирует обычные записи матчей, которые игра уже сохраняет, и формирует персональный «цифровой отпечаток» на основе индивидуальных привычек ввода:

В соревновательном шутере игроки тысячи раз повторяют одни и те же действия под давлением фактора времени: флики, контр-стрейфы, контроль отдачи и броски гранат. Со временем эти движения переходят на уровень подсознательной мышечной памяти. Вы можете сменить ник, звание, аккаунт, оружие и даже общий стиль игры. Но изменить собственные руки куда сложнее.

— объяснил автор диссертации.

В ходе испытаний на выборке из более чем тысячи игроков система показала свою эффективность:

анализ движений мыши безошибочно определил пользователя во всех 100% случаев;

паттерны нажатий клавиатуры показали точность в 98%;

комбинация двух метрик безошибочно подтвердила все 13 известных исследователю тестовых пар аккаунтов одного и того же человека.

Что еще более интересно, в процессе тестирования система попутно разоблачила скрытых смурфов: несколько совпадений, которые автор сперва посчитал ложным срабатыванием, но при детальной проверке оказались дополнительными твинками игроков из базы данных. По замыслу создателя, данная технология могла бы работать в связке с VAC и системой «Фактора доверия». Это позволило бы античиту распознавать заблокированного игрока сразу же, как только тот садится за новую учетную запись.

Впрочем, исследователь признал и текущие ограничения проекта: метод пока не проходил испытания на миллионной аудитории серверов Valve, а также может давать сбои, если за одним компьютером поочередно играют несколько членов семьи. По этой причине автор рекомендует на первых порах использовать биометрический отпечаток как весомую улику для системы патруля, а не как повод для мгновенного бана. Разработчик надеется, что представители Valve или соревновательных платформ вроде FACEIT обратят внимание на исследование и помогут протестировать технологию в реальных условиях.

newsitems.title: Inside the Trove of Terror
newsitems.author: eugenep
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/44e04da47da8b634dee235756e4ffa1234879b40.png"][/img][/p][p]Some time ago, a time now none of us can quite recall, we began to set our minds on matters of the monstrous. Our work has always concerned itself with the manufacture of frightening things, so there was no reason at that time for alarm.[/p][p]Until we began to fill a new treasure chest with item sets themed around eldritch and otherworldly designs.[/p][p]As each horrific creation took more defined shape, unsettling yet tantalizing inspirations took hold of us. Fantastical and Immortal glamours coalesced around each and every set; they grew more spellbinding, a vision that would remain, stuck fast in the mind's eye. Thoughts of monsters birthed thoughts of even more monstrous monsters. Our minds became gateways for greater abominations still, our hands became not our own.[/p][p]Soon our collection of new item sets numbered fifteen, eldritch abominations from the realm of nightmare all. We knew each thing was hideous. Not one of us could look away. Not one of us was content to stop there.[/p][p]To master horrors, we required greater horrors... We required ARCANA.[/p][p]Our first attempt summoned the haunting shape of a Drow Ranger Arcana long thought lost to the flow of time. By some trick of the mind, she can look as she once did or assume a grave-stalking new form.[/p][p]Our appetites remained unsatisfied.[/p][p]Our second attempt unleashed something none of us had ever seen, something that hungrily emerged from a bloodstained sea: the all-new Maw of the Megalodon Arcana for the creature called Tidehunter, arriving with a new model, a host of custom animations, effects, taunts, voice lines, and dragging a familiar-looking corpse that serves as one part security blanket and one part snack. A whisper in the darkness, instructing, teasing: "Should one master this Arcana's secrets, one would surely unlock all three of its shark-toothed designs."[/p][p]This Trove is a doorway to things we cannot explain, let alone understand. The more of these treasures that you open, the more your own minds shine out like beacons to things lurking beyond the limits of reason. Open enough treasures and you're guaranteed to attract the gaze of an all-seeing new Tormentor. Open a number more and you'll surely summon the face of eldritch terror itself, manifesting as an incomprehensible new design for Roshan.[/p][p]We must part now with one final revelation. Take it as a warning if you wish. We didn't make this treasure... It made itself. We thought we were creating something, but we were not. We were merely the conduit, unknowingly letting something into our world from the great dark beyond: The Trove of Terror — overflowing with a mind-bending number of Immortal item sets, one new and one returning Arcana, and brand-new Tormentor and Roshan appearances — available now.[/p][p]If you dare, all you need to do is launch Dota to learn more.[/p]
